name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Westminster
when_note: Saturday, December 12, 2026, 9 to 11 AM, arrive by 9 AM
cost: From $27.94 per ticket, sold through Fever
ages: All ages, tickets required for ages 2 and up
paras: Dave & Buster's Westminster opens its doors early on Saturday, December 12, 2026 for a ticketed Breakfast with Santa, running 9 to 11 AM at 10667 Westminster Blvd. Families get the arcade and dining room before the public arrives.

A ticket covers a breakfast banquet with pancakes, eggs, bacon and fruit, unlimited non-alcoholic drinks, kid-friendly crafts and a personal photo with Santa. Santa's Ultimate Workshop tickets add a $10 Power Card with 3 hours of unlimited video game play. Everyone age 2 and older needs a ticket, and tickets are not sold at the door.
tip: Buy tickets online ahead of time and buy them in one order if you want to sit together at the shared tables.
